title: Austin Dam Upgrades, New Gas Lines & Traffic Fixes
summary:
*   **Austin Dam Utility Upgrade:** Approved the Lower Colorado River Authority (LCRA) to install conduits through the Austin Dam for city telephone and electric services, with the city funding the installation costs (estimated around $5,000 plus overhead).
*   **Traffic Relief Project:** Permitted a property owner on East 43rd Street to set back a curb at their expense, creating a wider travel lane to improve traffic flow and ease congestion, with construction adhering to strict city standards.
*   **New Gas Line Installation:** Authorized Texas Public Service Company to lay new gas mains in several city streets and alleys, including Linscomb Avenue and East 13th Street, under strict city engineering and supervision requirements.
